verdict.rationale: Netlify's own integrations directory lists starters and templates for common use cases: a Remix + Supabase starter, a bare-bones Angular project that "has everything you need to quickly deploy it to Netlify," and a Clerk B2C template. The evidence never describes a one-click deploy mechanism for them, so only the templates themselves are documented. Missing for 10: explicit one-click deploy flow, a broader template catalog or docs, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a developer, I can deploy one-click templates and starters for common use cases

citations.quote: The Remix Supabase starter demonstrates how to integrate Supabase into an Remix project deployed on Netlify.
This is a bare-bones Angular project that has everything you need to quickly deploy it to Netlify.
The Clerk B2C template on Netlify makes it simple to launch a production-ready B2C application with authentication and user management
